page_title: WOL 1-3 DOR | Wolfsburg v Dortmund 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+4' Matthias Jollenbeck has issued a yellow card to Yan Couto (Dortmund).
90+3' A corner kick by Wolfsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Gregor Kobel (Dortmund).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.
88' Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gregor Kobel, who smothers the ball.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) for Julian Brandt.
87' Nuri Sahin prepares a substitution. Jamie Gittens is replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Joakim Maehle as he is replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Mohamed Amoura cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
85' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
84' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
84' Wolfsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

84' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Gregor Kobel is equal to it and makes an easy save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
83' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
83' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Wolfsburg will have a corner.
82' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
80' Neat passing move from Dortmund in order to create new attacking opportunities.

78' He should have scored! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the right post is pretty weak and Gregor Kobel makes an easy save.
77' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
75' Here is a change. Yannick Gerhardt is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximilian Beier leaves the pitch and Yan Couto (Dortmund) comes on.
73' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Wolfsburg players are visibly unhappy with the call.

73' Play continues despite the shouts by some Wolfsburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
72' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
71' Emre Can (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
70' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
68' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared away by the defence.
67' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Dortmund for a penalty. Play continues.
66' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
65' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
65' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
64' A substitution has been made. Donyell Malen is replaced by Waldemar Anton (Dortmund).
63' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is given a yellow card.
62' We have witnessed a sending-off! Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is given a red card for his dangerous challenge. Matthias Jollenbeck's decision is final.
60' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
58' 1 - 3 Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range low into the middle of the net. The score is 1:3.
58' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolfsburg.
57' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
56' The game is interrupted as Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is flagged offside.
55' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Pascal Gross (Dortmund) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
55' The foul by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.
54' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
53' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.

53' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
50' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
50' Wolfsburg fail to score from a corner as Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) leaps to collect the ball.

49' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Gregor Kobel makes a great save to stop his effort. Wolfsburg get a corner.
47' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a switch. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) is coming on in place of Mattias Svanberg at the start of the second period.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Kilian Fischer comes off for Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
43' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kamil Grabara intercepts the ball.
42' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
41' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) is penalised for holding. Matthias Jollenbeck signals a set piece.
38' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pascal Gross (Dortmund).
37' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.

35' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
33' 37:63 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

30' 0 - 3 Goal! Maximilian Beier sets up Julian Brandt (Dortmund) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom left corner. 0:3.

28' 0 - 2 Julian Brandt looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Maximilian Beier (Dortmund), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the left post. The score is 0:2.
26' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals that there was no infringement and the goal stands! The Dortmund players celebrate.
26' The Dortmund players halt their celebrations as referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

25' 0 - 1 Donyell Malen (Dortmund) blasts the ball inside the right post after a well-executed corner kick deep into the box. Thanks to his strong and precise shot, the goalkeeper had no chance of stopping it.
24' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.
23' 0:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
19' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Close! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
17' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

16' Ambitious effort from Julian Brandt (Dortmund). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
15' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner kick, but Kamil Grabara reads it well and stops the effort.
11' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
10' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
7' It seemed like Pascal Gross (Dortmund) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
7' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Matthias Jollenbeck stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
5' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

2' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
2' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Dortmund will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Matthias Jollenbeck.
